an8.72:1.1: saddho bhikkhave bhikkhu hoti no sīlavā
an8.72:1.2: evaṃ so tena aṅgena aparipūro hoti
an8.72:1.4: kinnāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā cāti
an8.72:1.5: yato ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca
an8.72:1.6: evaṃ so tena aṅgena paripūro hoti.
an8.72:2.1: saddho ca bhikkhave bhikkhu hoti sīlavā ca no bahussuto …pe…
an8.72:2.4: parisāvacaro ca no visārado parisāya dhammaṃ deseti …pe…
an8.72:2.5: visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseti ye ca te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe arūpā
an8.72:2.6: te kāyena phusitvā viharati no āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
an8.72:2.7: evaṃ so tena aṅgena aparipūro hoti
an8.72:2.9: kinnāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā ca bahussuto ca dhammakathiko ca parisāvacaro ca visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ ye ca te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe arūpā te kāyena phusitvā vihareyyaṃ āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyanti
an8.72:3.1: yato ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca bahussuto ca dhammakathiko ca parisāvacaro ca visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseti ye ca te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe arūpā te kāyena phusitvā viharati āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
an8.72:3.2: evaṃ so tena aṅgena paripūro hoti.
an8.72:3.3: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu samantapāsādiko ca hoti sabbākāraparipūro cāti. 80
